_why: A ce.structure-report tree shaped to hit every unary-chain boundary the two GUI lenses fold over, so cli/tests/gui/lens_invariant.js can assert on it hermetically instead of on whatever this repository happens to look like today. Node 0 is a single-child ROOT (the case that used to cost the root its heat exemption and inflate the colour scale); node 1 carries findings while having exactly one child (the case that used to be folded away and rendered nowhere); node 2 is a genuinely empty pass-through the fold SHOULD still swallow; nodes 4 and 5 sit past depth 3 behind a chain, which is what the default-expansion seed and test have to agree about.
